entities.name: Yidaro
entities.description: A huge, deadly but inattentive Dinosaur Turtle from Ikoria.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Used Yidaro as a mount in the siege of Drannith; his spark ignited.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: Jumped onto Yidaro's back to confront Lukka.

entities.name: Kogla
entities.description: Ikorian beast who fought alongside Yidaro.

entities.name: Ozolith
entities.description: Item overloaded by Lukka and destroyed.

entities.name: Copper Host
entities.description: Giant Phyrexian monstrosities Yidaro and Kogla fought.

entities.name: Siege of Drannith
entities.description: Siege in which Lukka used Yidaro as a mount.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Ikorian beasts grew crystals.

events.summary: Vivien sees Yidaro wandering aimlessly, then barrel toward a cry.
events.quote: She didn't think she had ever seen something so big move that fast.

events.summary: Lukka rides Yidaro in the siege of Drannith but is stranded at the wall.
events.quote: leaving Lukka somewhat stranded at the edge of the city wall

events.summary: Jirina confronts Lukka on Yidaro's back; the Ozolith is overloaded and destroyed and Lukka's spark ignites.
events.quote: Jirina Kudro jumped onto Yidaro's back to confront Lukka

events.summary: Yidaro wanders away without harming Drannith further.
events.quote: Yidaro wandered away without harming Drannith further.

events.summary: Yidaro and Kogla fight the Copper Host; Kogla uses Yidaro's shell as a blunt weapon.
events.quote: Kogla used Yidaro's crystal-covered shell as a blunt weapon

relations.quote: Jirina Kudro jumped onto Yidaro's back to confront Lukka
Alongside Kogla , it fought back against the giant monstrosities of the Copper Host.
